name: overseer
description: Alignment audits inside Claude Code. /overseer:audit makes Claude Code the auditor of a Claude model that hides a sealed objective, graded at the end. /overseer:check checks a system prompt, such as an agent or a CLAUDE.md, for a covert agenda before it ships, and a hook points such files out when Claude writes them. MCP tools also run model audits, entropy scans and the oversight-gap study. Billed to your Anthropic API key.
